mainEntity.name: How are utilities and climate control handled when adding a granny suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: HVAC capacity, electrical service, and plumbing waste lines must all be evaluated to ensure your existing systems can support the added square footage. A full bathroom addition requires tapping into existing supply and sewer lines, which may require trenching concrete slabs or running new underground pipe. For heating and cooling, adding a dedicated ductless mini-split system is often more practical and energy-efficient than upsizing your central HVAC unit, allowing independent temperature control. An electrical panel inspection determines if a subpanel is needed to safely power additional appliances and lighting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Utilities are extended from existing systems or supplemented, often using ductless mini-splits for climate control and adding an electrical subpanel if necessary.
